qas.question: Can the long-term profitability of each crop per hectare be calculated?

assumptions: Triệu USD; nghìn ore tonnes, nghìn metal tonnes. Mỏ hư cấu Sỏi Hồng. Toy payable metal measured after recovery/payability; production cost includes extraction/processing and UOP depletion allocated to output, matched to sold quantity. Royalty gross sales. No tax beyond listed.

evidence.text: [Production p.12] Ore mined and processed1.000kt, grade2%, recovery85%, payability90%. All saleable output homogeneous. Payable metal sold14kt, closing unsold balance, no opening inventory.
[Prices p.15] Realized gross sale price $7.500/metal tonne, treatment charge $200/t sold reduces consideration. Royalty 5% of gross sale value. All accepted, no provisional pricing.

[Cost p.18] Extraction/processing cash-type cost60m for whole output. Mine PPE opening240, revised recoverable ore reserves at Jan1 12m tonnes, zero residual. UOP depletion on ore extracted, allocated to produced metal inventory cost.
[ARO p.25] Opening closure provision40, annual unwind2, upward revision10 capitalized to PPE at year-end (noncash, no depletion this year), cash closure payment5 uses provision. No other movements.
[Other P&L p.20] Selling/admin12, interest8 outside unwind, tax5. No inventory write-down, other expenses or gains. Royalties expensed in period on sales.
[AR p.29] Opening gross AR10, all net metal consideration invoiced, cash receipts95, no writeoff.

[Cash p.32] Extraction/processing cash paid58 (2 unpaid current cost, no opening payable), all royalty and selling/admin paid, interest8, tax4 cash. Closure payment5 operating under toy. Cash growth capex30, no other cash capex. Opening cash25.
[Debt p.37] Opening debt100, proceeds50, principal20. No noncash debt. Cash capex30 ready next year, included PPE addition. No restricted cash.

[Deck p.5] Values all produced metal as sales; computes depletion per sold metal tonne using original reserve denominator; treats ARO revision10 as cash capex and closure payment5 as additional current expense.

qas.question: Find contained metal before recovery and payability.
Find total saleable payable metal produced.
Find ending physical saleable inventory quantity.
Find gross realized metal sales before treatment charge.
qas.answer: Only the 14kt payable metal actually sold counts. Gross realized sales = 14×7,500/1,000 = 105 million USD.

qas.question: Find net earned consideration after treatment charge.
qas.answer: Apply the treatment charge to 14kt sold, not all production: 14×(7,500−200)/1,000 = 102.2 million USD.

qas.question: Find royalty expense under gross-value base.
qas.answer: Gross sale value = 14×7,500/1,000 = 105m. Royalty is based on gross value, before treatment charge: 105×5% = 5.25 million USD.

qas.question: Find current depletion using ore extraction and revised reserves.
Find total current production cost pool including depletion.
Find matched COGS for the 14kt sold.
Find closing unsold metal carrying amount.
Find year-end closure obligation after unwind, revision and payment.
Find closing mine PPE including capitalized ARO revision and growth capex.
Calculate profit after tax including matched COGS, royalty and finance unwind.
Find cash generated from operations on the stated cash classification.
qas.answer: Royalty paid = 14×7,500/1,000×5% = 5.25m. Actual CFO = 95−58−5.25−12−8−4−5 = 2.75 million USD; closure cash payment is operating under the toy policy.

qas.question: Explain why the 10 ARO revision and 5 closure payment must not both enter current expense and cash capex.
qas.answer: Revision10 is a noncash PPE/liability addition; payment5 settles an existing obligation and is operating cash under toy, not a new expense. Unwind2 is current noncash finance expense.

qas.question: Can reserve life and expected mine NPV be reliably forecast from one year's output and remaining reserves?
qas.answer: No. A simple reserve/output ratio is possible, but actual mine plan, recovery variation, future prices, cash flows and discount inputs are absent.
